name: llm-eval-dashboard-backend
description: LLM eval dashboard: versioned datasets, prompts, model configs and scorers; eval runs fanned out case x sample to PostgreSQL SKIP LOCKED workers with leases, per-run concurrency and fairness; retries, 'N errored' outcomes, re-scoring without regeneration, paired comparisons with confidence intervals and provenance checks; mock model and mock judge processes with chaos switches

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,work1,work2,model,judge -c blue,yellow,yellow,magenta,cyan "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:worker1" "npm run dev:worker2" "npm run dev:model" "npm run dev:judge"
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,work1,work2,model,judge "tsx src/api/index.ts" "WORKER_PORT=3101 WORKER_ID=worker-1 tsx src/worker/index.ts" "WORKER_PORT=3102 WORKER_ID=worker-2 tsx src/worker/index.ts" "tsx src/model/index.ts" "tsx src/judge/index.ts"
